headline: Dhaka hospital: Family alleges medical negligence in infant's death
summary: The family of a deceased infant has raised concerns over the quality of care provided at a Dhaka-based hospital.
details: A family in Dhaka has alleged medical negligence leading to the death of their infant child.
The allegations were brought forward by the family members who believe the hospital's care was insufficient or improper.
The incident has sparked concerns regarding patient safety and medical standards in private healthcare facilities in the capital.
The family is seeking accountability and a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding the infant's death.
